item.title: Nier Automata Remake
item.description:
Introduction

This game was made with the goal of learning and master Unreal Engine, as I come from Unity. I played a lot of Nier Automata and was fascinated to know how big games are made and wanted also to try in Unreal how they do that. I really wanted to challenge myself with creating RE:Imagery.

As a programmer I tried to implement everything the only things that I took from others was animations, models and 2D arts. The game splits like nier automata in 2 clear gameplay mechanics, top down flight shooter and 3D hack and slash.
